messages:
mira: Heads-up — I started a tiny PoC for an audit-friendly telemetry pipeline to satisfy SOC/PCI asks. Goal: queryable spans without leaking PII, with provable provenance. Curious if anyone has quick thoughts before I wire up a demo.

jon: Nice. What constraints are we optimizing for (latency, cost, investigator UX)?

mira: Priorities: 1) no raw PII in exporters or long-term stores unless strictly gated; 2) re-identification must be auditable and KMS/HSM gated; 3) retention must be per-tenant and declaratively configured; 4) investigators can run ad-hoc queries but see only pseudonymous IDs unless approved. Low-latency is secondary for PoC.

olga: For (2) — we should avoid storing reversible tokens in plaintext. Pattern that works: store one-way hash for day-to-day use + encrypted reversible blob in a separate, heavily-audited store (KMS-wrapped). Re-id requests unlock the blob with KMS and are logged.

rahul: Agreed. Implementation sketch: span -> scrubber plugin -> pseudonymize(attr) -> envelope-encrypt(pseudonym_meta) -> exporter. Exporter writes: pseudonym hash, exporter_id, key_id, redaction_version, provenance: {source_host, route}. Example metadata (for audits):
```
{"pseudonym":"sha256:...","exporter_id":"eng-rw-01","key_id":"kms:projects/.../keys/audit-v1","redaction_version":"v2","source":"ingress-gateway"}
```

security-bot: Flag: ensure key rotation doesn't break pending investigations. Keep a rotation map and a short-term key-archive accessible only to Security SREs. All re-id ops must create an immutable audit record (requestor, reason, key_used, timestamp).

jon: UX question — how do we expose choices in the Console? I propose per-route policy with quick presets: "no PII", "pseudonymize 7d", "retain raw 30d (legal)". Console should show active key id, last rotation, and number of re-id events in the last 90 days.

mira: PoC plan: build an exporter plugin named `telemetry-audit-poc` that emits pseudonymized spans and a matching audit-manifest S3 object for each batch. Test matrix: tenant EU-1 (7d retention, pseudonymize), tenant ACME (30d reversible, legal-allowlist). Re-id flow: investigator requests via internal UI -> PV approval -> KMS unwrap -> audit record created.

olga: Also add automatic detection for accidental unredacted attributes: regex/allowlist checks in the scrubber. If detected, block-forward and trigger canary-fallback (switch exporter to safe-mode). Suggest an eval hook run in CI that scans recent spans for patterns.

rahul: I'll prototype KMS-envelope integration + exporter plugin skeleton. Plan to open PR by Thursday with a runnable PoC (local mode + S3 manifest).

mira: Sweet. I'll make a brief Confluence page and add this to the PoC board. Thanks all :thumbsup:
